decisions.reason: The award-winning launch and its fit with long-term energy-transition demand make this geothermal probe likely worth keeping in the portfolio.
As a complementary geothermal probe variant, it is likely retained to round out the range unless sales proved clearly weak.
This surface technology supports the geothermal product family, though as a more specialized add-on it carries somewhat higher discontinuation risk.
A fire-protection steel profile system sits close to the firm's core metal-building business and should benefit from steady regulatory demand.
A slim steel profile system is a plausible architectural extension of the core business and is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon after launch.
The decorative steel profile surface system is more niche, but it still adds value and differentiation within the firm's established profile business.
